content.title: ‘The Masked Singer’ Crowns Winner: Galaxy Girl Unmasked As Season 14 Champ
content.text: Skip to main content ‘The Masked Singer’ Crowns Winner: Galaxy Girl Unmasked As Season 14 Champ Galaxy Girl on 'The Masked Singer' Michael Becker/Fox SPOILERS: This post contains details about The Masked Singer, Season 14 finale The Season 14 winner of The Masked Singer has been revealed, and it’s as if we knew her better than she ever knew herself. On Wednesday’s two-hour season finale, during which she performed Olivia Rodrigo’s ‘Good 4 U’ and P!nk’s ‘Try’, Galaxy Girl was crowned the winner and unmasked as Ashlee Simpson, with sister Jessica Simpson on hand to help her make the reveal. “Honestly, I’m kind of freaking out right now,” said Simpson after winning. “I’ve literally had the best experience of my life her. I love you guys. I have grown so much here, and I can’t believe I won. Everyone is incredible.” Related Stories In second place was Pugcasso, unmasked as Phillip Phillips; with third going to Cat Witch, revealed to be Kylie Cantrall; and in fourth was Crane, who was unmasked as Normani. Watch on Deadline 1/1 Skip Ad Continue watchingafter the adVisit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGE Ashlee added of the competition, “It’s shown me a lot, really, for myself. Because people think this is just so easy. It has been hard work. And by the way, I’ve had many bruises because I fall to my knees every day.” Special guest Jessica Simpson and Ashlee Simpson Ross as Galaxy Girl on ‘The Masked Singer’, Season 14 finale (Michael Becker/Fox) Jessica said her younger sister “deserves the stage,” adding that she’s “always her number-one fan.” With their daughters in the audience, Ashlee also talked about competing against husband Evan Ross, who was previously unmasked as Stingray in Week 10. “We were competing against each other, and it was wild, because we couldn’t see each other,” she said. Last year, Fox Entertainment CEO Rob Wade said the competition reality show was experimenting with releasing only one cycle this year, instead of two, which means it could be 2027 until Season 15.
